reviews.text: What a fantastic experience! We arrived with our dog, who was covered in knots. We have had bad experiences with other groomers, so we were very nervous. He treated our dog incredibly well and we are super happy, so definitely highly recommended! Thanks again so much!

Orlando gave Olaf a really great haircut. He’s getting lots of compliments from people on the street: ‘What a beautiful dog!’ Olaf isn’t a fan of grooming, but luckily it worked really well for Orlando. Until next time!

What a fantastic place! Moos was immediately completely at ease thanks to the lovely atmosphere. Olando does this so well, with so much love for the dog. Highly recommended; Moos looks beautiful and clean again.
Olando is a dog whisperer. Mila loves going there and always comeback home looking cute and fresh.

What a wonderful experience! ❤️ I am incredibly satisfied with how sweet and caring Orlando was with Bruno. You notice immediately that he truly has love and attention for dogs. When I came to pick Bruno up, he looked beautiful, clean, and perfectly groomed! 🐾✨ I am very happy and will definitely be back. Highly recommended! ❤️

As a first time owner of a tiny toy poodle, I really appreciate my first appointment with Olando! He’s done a great job at taking care of the puppy and gave me really useful tips and advice on the daily care between the grooming sessions. I couldnt have asked for a better experience! Thank you Olando, and see you next time!

I visited here for the first time recently with my dog ​​and I'm really happy with it!

You can just tell that he really does it out of love and has a heart for dogs. He also sent updates in between, which I really appreciated. Haze was really super soft and very beautifully groomed 🖤
I visited Orlando for the first time today and am super happy with the result. My two pups were completely at ease and came home fluffy and smelling great 😃

Great experience! My puppy,Suzy, had her first grooming appointment, and everything went perfectly. The salon was spotless, he was patient and friendly, and I received regular updates, which I really appreciated. We’ve already booked our next appointment. Highly recommend!
Received super puppy treatment, so happy with it!
Jackie was beautifully groomed and felt completely at home. Thanks for the good care and see you at the next haircut.

So happy to find Orlando! We adopted our dog 5 years ago and have no idea what breeds he is but every single groomer has given him a poodle cut (even when we asked them not to). Orlando did not do that - he listened to me and gave me some suggestions, and our dog came out with this very unique, non-poodle cut that was adorable!!! Orlando is going to be our go-to groomer from now on.
Absolutely amazed with the job he did. He spend so much time working with Daisy (she is not the easiest) and got her looking fabulous. We will definitely be coming back!!
Such lovely experience. Took great care of our beloved doggie and went out of his way to help!
Beautiful trim, very friendly and good communication!
It was our puppy's first professional grooming, and we're really happy it.
Orlando did the best job possible for my Shibas, they looked and smelled amazing! My male Shiba was dramatic and aggressive, but in the end he was well groomed and looked after. Thank you!
Olando is a wonderful, kind professional. My puppy was immediately at ease with him and Maximus. You can see and feel his passion for dogs and dog grooming. We will keep coming back 💖🐶 …
Amazing service!! My dog Nico had a great time and Orlando was very kind to him! I would definitely recommend this groomer 100%. We will continue to bring Nico here from.now on ☺️
Olando was lovely and took great care of Reina. She looks great! Thanks
Olando takes great care of Idli and ensures he looks amazing every time. He is also very good at ensuring follow ups. I’d definitely reccomend his services.
Olando did a great job with Ping Ping’s haircut! She  hasn’t been looking so good for a while! We highly recommend his service, it’s 10/10!

I am very satisfied with the service provided
It was the first time for my Maltipoo puppy, and I have to say that even though it was our first time, we felt right at home; we were kept informed of every step he would take with our puppy.
But the best part for me was that during the session, he shared videos of what was happening during the treatment.
I highly recommend it

Orlando is kind, professional and clearly loves dogs and has a perfect understanding of how to make them feel safe. It was my puppy’s first grooming experience and i can tell how much he loved it. Plus he looks stunning and his smell is absolutely wonderful! 10/10

What a great experience I had with Olando this week. He made time in his very busy schedule for our newly adopted stabydoodle! The appointment started with getting our dog settled and comfortable, which left me feeling comfortable as well. Olando really connects with the dog and it is apparent that he really cares and takes pride in what he does. Olando sent pictures and videos during the service to keep us updated  with how the dog was doing. Our dog had the best haircut and he smells heavenly now.

I highly recommend this place! Olando  is very talented and so nice. He took such great care with our dog who looks better than ever before after a grooming appointment. So grateful to have found this grooming salon!

I have been looking after a French Bulldog for a month now who was severely neglected by a previous sitter over the past six months. When Biggie came to me, he was very dirty and smelled terrible. Fortunately, he was able to go to Orlando for a freshen-up within a week.

From the moment we walked in, we immediately felt that Orlando has a wonderful energy and genuinely cares about the dogs. Biggie was helped so well and looks and feels completely fresh and well-groomed again.

Orlando, I am incredibly grateful to you, and I think Biggie is too ☺️

Amazing.

Our big girl (28 kg shepherd mix) does NOT like haircuts, but she loved her time with Maximus & Friends. She was treated with great love and affection from the minute we dropped her off. When we picked her up, she was beaming - and her coat looks amazing!

My 8-month-old puppy received a fantastic grooming from Olando! He's very considerate of your needs and is very thoughtful and meticulous. My Doodle wasn't stressed at all because the environment is pleasant and Olando works calmly. I'll definitely be back and would highly recommend this grooming salon.

I have two doodles and I have been to quite a few groomers in Amsterdam over the past 5 years. If you are looking for a groomer that doesn't just cut your dogs hair but actually STYLES IT, this is your guy. My doodles look amazing and it's all due to the fact that Olando is super detail oriented and takes a lot of pride in his work. He is very professional and kind. We are so grateful we were recommended to him. My doodles were very happy too.

It was a new experience for my puppy, and everything was calm and gentle — no stress. She came out happy and well-groomed: clean, neatly trimmed, with nails done and ears taken care of.

Thank you for the great work and kind attitude!
My 16-week-old puppy went to Olando's today for a checkup. Olando was super sweet, caring, and knowledgeable. Kees looks handsome again. We'll definitely be back.
This groomer is fantastic, so caring, attentive, gentle and talented! Love my dog's cut - he is a big doodle - I highly recommend him and his service!
Thank you, Caroline! I'm glad you're happy with the result :)
Good hairdresser for a fair price. My Labradoodle got a perfect haircut here.
